 Thunderstorms, damaging winds and fire danger warnings issued for Monday across several provinces
 Compiled by Tshehla Cornelius Koteli 
 Business journalist 
 3 minute read
 25 October 2026
 05:24 pm
 RELATED ARTICLES
 Free State principal suspended for denying pupil to write exams over unpaid fees 
 Severe storms and extreme fire danger expected on Sunday in KZN, Eastern Cape 
 Find out what the latest weather forecast means for your region on 26 October.
 Picture: iStock 
 Add as Preferred Source on Google 
 Follow on Google News 
 South Africans in several provinces face severe weather conditions on Monday, with thunderstorms, heavy downpours, damaging winds, hail and lightning expected in some areas. 
 At the same time, extremely high fire danger threatens parts of the interior.
 According to the South African Weather Service (Saws), parts of KwaZulu-Natal (KZN) and the Eastern Cape can expect severe thunderstorms with heavy downpours, damaging winds, hail, and lightning, resulting in localised flooding and damage to infrastructure and settlements.
 Western parts of the Free State and the extreme eastern parts of the Northern Cape can expect damaging winds, causing localised damage to settlements, localised loss of agricultural production, and affecting some transport routes and travel services due to wind, falling trees, or dust storms.
 A fire warning is also in effect for the North-West, central and eastern Northern Cape, most of the Free State and Limpopo, and parts of western KZN and eastern Northern Cape.

 Provincial weather forecast
 Here’s what to expect in your province on Monday, 26 October: 
 Gauteng: 
 Partly cloudy and warm to hot with isolated afternoon showers and thundershowers in the south.
 Mpumalanga: 
 Partly cloudy and warm with isolated showers and thundershowers over the eastern and southern Highveld. It will be hot to very hot in the Lowveld.

 Partly cloudy, windy and hot but warm in the extreme south, with isolated afternoon showers and thundershowers in the east.

 Cloudy with isolated showers and rain in the south and adjacent eastern interior, where it will be cool and warm; otherwise fine and warm, but partly cloudy along the west.

 Western half of the Eastern Cape: 
 Partly cloudy and warm in the north, otherwise cloudy and cool with isolated showers and rain along the coast and adjacent interior. Isolated thunderstorms are expected over the interior and in the north, where it will become partly cloudy from late morning.
 Eastern half of the Eastern Cape: 
 Partly cloudy in the north; otherwise cloudy and cool, with cold in places and scattered showers and thunderstorms.
 KZN: 
 Morning fog patches over the interior, otherwise partly cloudy and cool to warm but hot in places in the north with scattered showers and thundershowers.
